title: Security
intro: Verify the email domains of your organisation. A verified domain can bring new accounts into this workspace by themselves, and require single sign-on for its addresses.
addRecord: Add this DNS record to the domain, then verify. DNS changes can take a few minutes to show.
captureHint: Anyone signing up with an @{domain} address joins this workspace as a member.
enforceHint: @{domain} addresses sign in with {provider} only: no password, no email link.
noProvider: Set up a single sign-on provider for the instance first (OIDC_* variables).
enforceConfirm: From now on, @{domain} addresses can only sign in with {provider}. Check that it works for you before turning this on.
removeConfirm: Remove {domain}? New accounts are no longer captured and single sign-on is no longer required for it.

sso.title: Identity providers
sso.intro: Your company's sign-in (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, Keycloak…) for the addresses of your verified domains. Existing accounts of these addresses are linked to it; new ones join this workspace.
sso.verifyFirst: Verify a domain above first: a provider only signs in addresses of verified domains.
sso.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}”? Its people sign in with a password or an email link again, unless single sign-on is required.
sso.name: Name
sso.issuerHint: Its discovery document must be at /.well-known/openid-configuration.
sso.entryPoint: Single sign-on URL of the provider
sso.certificateHint: The X.509 certificate of the provider, in PEM or base64.
sso.afterSave: Once saved, the addresses to give your provider are shown here.

ldap.title: Company directory (LDAP)
ldap.intro: People of your verified domains sign in with their directory password (LDAP, Active Directory). Ronde looks them up with a service account, then checks their password; it never keeps it.
ldap.urlHint: ldaps:// is encrypted; with ldap://, turn StartTLS on.
ldap.passwordKept: Saved: leave empty to keep it.
ldap.userFilterHint: '{{email}}' is replaced by the address typed on the sign-in page.
ldap.removeConfirm: Remove the company directory? Its people sign in with a Ronde password or an email link again, unless single sign-on is required.
ldap.found: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody found for this address.} one {Found: the directory knows this person.} other {# people found: the filter must match one person only.}}

scim.title: Provisioning (SCIM)
scim.intro: Your company directory (Okta, Entra ID, JumpCloud…) creates people here, keeps their name and address up to date, and removes them when they leave. Removed people leave the workspace; their history stays.
scim.copyNow: Copy this token now and paste it in your directory: it will not be shown again.
scim.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{name}”? The directory using it can no longer provision people.
scim.name: Token name
